item.title: Fedora Workstation (GNOME) & Stylus/Eraser Bring-Up Plan for Google Jamboard
item.description: Overview This guide documents the end-to-end hardware architecture, reverse-engineering workflow, and installation procedure for running stock Fedora Workstation (aarch64, GNOME on Wayland)—with full multi-touch, passive stylus, physical eraser, and display backlight support—on a Google Jamboard (codename baracus). Because the Jamboard’s passive stylus and eraser currently lack complete tool-type/eraser handling in open-source ROMs, this plan uses a two-stage execution strategy:

item.title: Live Input Capture Findings for the Google Jamboard RAPT Touch Controller (LineageOS)
item.description: Overview These are measurements taken from a live Jamboard running lineage-22.2-20261109-NIGHTLY-baracus_tab (Android 15, kernel 4.9.141, userdebug, SELinux Enforcing), captured over Root ADB from /dev/hidraw*. They replace the size-band assumptions derived from static analysis of the stock ROM and are the basis for the classification in artifacts/jamboard/jamboard-pen-daemon.c. Captures were taken with a finger, the stock passive stylus (upright and tilted), a substitute whiteboard eraser (the official Jamboard eraser was not available), the heel of a palm, and the stylus with a palm resting beside it. About 34,100 contact rows were analyzed. Small derived artifacts are in artifacts/jamboard/captures/: both HID report descriptors (raw and decoded) and phase-summary.csv. The multi-megabyte raw captures were not committed.

item.title: RAPT Optical Touch/Stylus HID & MStar Scaler UART Protocol Guide
item.description: Overview This guide provides the complete wire-level protocol specification and Linux/Android integration setup for the Google Jamboard’s two custom carrier-board subsystems: RAPT Touch (“HazelRed” / hazeldos) Optical InGlass Digitizer: GPIO SPIFI power-up sequence, USB HID Report 0xF1 frame specification (basic 340-byte and extended 484-byte interfaces), live capture workflow on LineageOS, and uinput stylus/eraser translation (jamboard-pen-daemon). MStar MST9U23T1 Display Scaler (/dev/ttyTHS1): 9600-baud UART packet framing, XOR checksum algorithm, backlight brightness control, external HDMI/USB-C DisplayPort input switching, and speaker mute control (jamboard-scaler.sh). Prerequisites Unlocked Google Jamboard (baracus) running either LineageOS 22 (baracus_tab) with Root ADB or Fedora Workstation (aarch64). Companion scripts and C source from artifacts/jamboard/: artifacts/jamboard/rapt-live-probe.sh artifacts/jamboard/jamboard-pen-daemon.c artifacts/jamboard/jamboard-scaler.sh artifacts/jamboard/systemd/* Part 1: RAPT Optical Touchscreen & Stylus/Eraser Subsystem 1.1 GPIO Power-Up & SPIFI Boot Sequence The internal RAPT Touch controller (VID:PID 1cbe:0003 on Jamboard; 2986:0137 on generic RAPT firmware) is wired to internal Tegra XUSB port usb2-3 (usb-70090000.xusb-4).
